question: On the certified travelling bases of COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001A-E001 (r = 3 to 6), how many independent travelling directions does each have, and how does the least window bond to far distinctions grow across the shift (rank 1) or around the origin (rank 2)?

definitions.samples: every base classed travels at r = 3..6 in main.json (sha256 7efa22a616b0625323fbd13ac37bb1d17a76ca7bbb15cfabc8fccfbe2ab2a1f0)
definitions.dirs: certified travelling along each of the ten census shifts (A of 2..4 cells in [0,1] x [0,2]); directions reduced to primitive; rank; common pattern
definitions.cross: rank 1: b(alpha, y) least window bond with the origin and (alpha, y) in the frame, one cross-section (|S| <= 5; alpha = 10, y = +-2..+-6; alpha = 14, y = +-3) and two cross-sections (|S| <= 4; alpha = 10, y = +-2..+-4); certified when parts are carried by frame-aligned torus states
definitions.rings: rank 2: least window bond (|S| <= 4 in the 3 x 3 box of frame cells) to targets m t1' + n t2' on the rings max(|m|,|n|) = 3 and 6
definitions.flat / line / open: rank-1 base: flat when b(10,+-6) - b(10,+-2) <= 1 wherever both defined (one cross-section) and some direction defined to 6; line when >= 2 in some direction; else open

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 c59ca676b7b91cf923efcd1293d099de9bdf30841643f9323741505ef4f6b2ca) beside this file; it imports COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001A-E001's census.py (sha256 6ad9de8183fc51a3920dd40b93476c89c5f96fbc13dfaf8458ad345dcd981523); pysat; 6 workers
public_inputs.run: --part control, then --part dirs, then --part cross and --part rings; outputs in artifacts/TRAVEL-READ-20261112-001A/TRAVEL-READ-20261112-001A-E001_law_reading/

forbidden_inputs: Changing samples, families, windows, tori, targets or predictions after seeing results
primary_observable: Rank distribution; per rank-1 base the class flat / line / open and b values; per rank-2 base the ring statistics
cheapest_meaningful_control: Base 16 (part control), whose profile is a theorem

predictions.T1: rank 2 >= 40% (Wilson lower bound >= 30%) at r = 4, 5 together; rank 1 >= 20%
predictions.T2: among decided rank-1 bases, flat >= 50% and line <= 20%
predictions.T3: b(14, +-3) = b(10, +-3) wherever both defined, in >= 90% of cases
predictions.T4: for >= 2/3 of rank-2 bases, >= 80% of ring-6 targets reached and max ring-6 b <= max ring-3 b
predictions.validity: control holds; <= 20% of bases dropped at the 1,200 s cap

decision_rules.T1-T4 hold: typical travelling bases read zero dimensions within the measured range; base 16's line is rare
decision_rules.T2 fails with many lines: base 16's line is common among rank-1 bases

stop_rule: One run of each part; hand-off to the referee thread.
runtime: About 10 to 20 minutes on 6 workers; each base saved as it finishes; cap 1,200 s per base; registered in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md.
